title: Capacity holdfast: finalize GPU tranche & MAP dates
text:
Capacity holdfast: finalize GPU tranche & MAP dates

["From: Evan Gross <evan.gross@acme.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity inquiry — committed runway & MAP

Hi Soojin,

We discussed high-level capacity yesterday and my execs want a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and a realistic close timeline for a committed GPU pool. Key asks:
- Lead times for Dedicated vs Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments
- Recommended tranche sizing for our initial commitment (we currently estimate 600–900 tokens/sec peak; ops team prefers headroom)
- Acceptance / go-live window and canary policy

We have procurement cycles and legal review that typically take 2–3 weeks after we sign. Can you send a suggested MAP with milestones we can insert into our purchase order? I'll loop in Procurement (Lydia).

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Gross
Head of ML Platforms, Acme.ai
E: evan.gross@acme.ai
T: +1 415-555-0123
(Attachment: acme_initial_requirements.pdf)", "From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Gross <evan.gross@acme.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity inquiry — committed runway & MAP

Evan —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass MAP (acme_map_v1.pdf) and a sizing workbook (h100_pool_sizing.xlsx). High level notes below — this is optimized for predictable latency and cost with an option to stagger delivery:

1) Lead times (typical)
- Redwood Dedicated (hosted, reserved): 6–10 weeks from contract signature for initial tranche activation (depends on GPU class and region).
- Redwood Private (VPC / customer-managed): 10–16 weeks when KMS/HSM and network handoff are required; on-prem appliances can stretch to 16+ weeks due to rack/ops scheduling.

2) Tranche recommendation (based on your 600–900 tps estimate)
- Option A (Conservative start): 8 x H100-equivalent instances (pool ~500–700 tps sustained with KV/cache optimizations)
- Option B (Staggered scale): Tranche 1 = 6 H100 for eval/canary (3–4 week ramp), Tranche 2 = +8 H100 at week 8 post-signature for full load.
- Option C (Aggressive): 16 H100 for immediate peak with 20% headroom.

3) Evaluation & acceptance
- Eval window: 14 calendar days of observed SLAs on your representative prompt set (we'll run 3 production-simulated workloads).
- Canary policy: Router directs 5–10% of traffic to the new pool for 72 hours; automatic rollback to pinned model variant on regression.

4) MAP milestones (suggested)
- Day 0: Contract signature (DocuSign link below)
- D+3: Kickoff + onboarding docs shared (mutual_action_plan-draft.docx)
- D+14: Tranche 1 deployment (smoke tests)
- D+21–28: Eval/acceptance window for Tranche 1
- D+56: Tranche 2 deployment (if applicable)

5) Acceptance criteria we need from Acme:
- Prompts/test-set for SLA gating (you can share via secure Drive link)
- Admin contacts for network and keys (for Private)

I'll need confirmation on preferred tranche split to lock procurement lead times. CC'd Karthik and Marissa for capacity scheduling and legal/finance handoffs.

Attachments: acme_map_v1.pdf, h100_pool_sizing.xlsx

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(Attachment: mutual_action_plan-draft.docx)", "From: Evan Gross <evan.gross@acme.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.procurement@acme.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity holdfast: finalize GPU tranche & MAP dates

Thanks Soojin — this is very helpful. Two quick clarifications:

1) Procurement: Lydia, can we compress our PO approvals to 7–10 business days if we have a pre-filled MAP and DocuSign?
2) Commercial: Evan (ops) asked about an early-termination credit if we oversubscribe in Tranche 2. Also curious about an incentive for committing to the staggered approach (e.g., lower monthly rate for Tranche 2).

We'll aim for Option B (Staggered) but want firm dates before our leadership commit. Please include the canary rollback SLA in the MAP explicitly (it should be part of the acceptance gates).

—Evan

Evan / Lydia —

Great — taking Option B (Staggered) as tentative. Summary of final asks and next steps so procurement can act:

- Commitment: Tranche 1 (6 H100) + Tranche 2 (+8 H100) — total 14 H100 equivalent
- Pricing: I'll propose a 10% step discount on Tranche 2 if committed at signature (I will confirm with finance & include in the commercial term sheet).
- Early-termination: We offer a usage-smoothing credit schedule (details in the attached MAP); I asked Finance for the exact formula and will share by EOD Friday.
- Canary / acceptance: Explicitly enumerated in MAP appendix A; rollback SLA = immediate reroute with 30-minute mitigation SLAs for critical regressions.
- Lead times: Dedicated = 6–9 weeks; Private = 12–16 weeks (finalized based on your infra readiness checklist).

Action items:
1) Lydia — if Procurement can commit to a 10-business-day PO window once DocuSign is in your queue, we will populate the DocuSign packet and include the Tranche 2 discount.
2) Evan — please upload the representative prompt set and admin contacts to the secure Drive link in the MAP.
3) Karthik/Marissa/Ben (internal) — block capacity calendar tentatively for D+14 and D+56; Marissa will run the acceptance runbook.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded/12345
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-4321

If Lydia confirms the 10-business-day PO cadence we'll circulate the DocuSign packet and lock dates. Thanks everyone — short and simple is best here.

Best,
Soojin Lee
